properties.text: encode_internal_node must only accept None, LeafNode, ExtensionNode, or BranchNode types.
properties.assertion: forall node: encode_internal_node(node) => node in {None, LeafNode, ExtensionNode, BranchNode}

properties.text: RLP encoding below 32 bytes returns unencoded form; at or above 32 bytes returns keccak256 hash.
properties.assertion: forall enc: len(rlp(node)) < 32 => return unencoded; len(rlp(node)) >= 32 => return keccak256(enc)

properties.text: Account nodes in encode_node must have a non-None storage_root.
properties.assertion: forall node: isinstance(node, Account) => storage_root is not None

properties.text: encode_node must fall back to previous_trie.encode_node for unrecognized types.
properties.assertion: forall node: not isinstance(node, {Account,LegacyTx,Receipt,Withdrawal,U256,Bytes}) => previous_trie.encode_node(node)

properties.text: Default values must be represented by absence from trie._data, not stored explicitly.
properties.assertion: forall k,v: trie_set(trie, k, v) && v == trie.default => k not in trie._data

properties.text: Setting a key to default value must delete it; setting non-default must store it.
properties.assertion: forall k,v: (v == default => del _data[k]) && (v != default => _data[k] = v)

properties.text: trie_get must return trie.default for missing keys, never raise an exception.
properties.assertion: forall k: k not in trie._data => trie_get(trie, k) == trie.default

properties.text: common_prefix_length must return value in [0, min(len(a), len(b))].
properties.assertion: forall a,b: 0 <= common_prefix_length(a,b) <= min(len(a), len(b))

properties.text: All nibble values in input to nibble_list_to_compact must be in range [0, 15].
properties.assertion: forall x: nibble_list_to_compact(x) => forall i: 0 <= x[i] <= 15

properties.text: nibble_list_to_compact first byte high nibble must encode is_leaf flag and parity correctly.
properties.assertion: compact[0] >> 4 == (2*is_leaf + (len(x)%2 != 0))

properties.text: bytes_to_nibble_list output length must be exactly 2 * input length.
properties.assertion: forall b: len(bytes_to_nibble_list(b)) == 2 * len(b)

properties.text: bytes_to_nibble_list and nibble_list_to_compact must be inverse operations modulo header.
properties.assertion: forall b: nibble_list_to_compact(bytes_to_nibble_list(b), is_leaf)[1:] preserves b

properties.text: All encoded values in _prepare_trie output must be non-empty; empty encoding must assert.
properties.assertion: forall v in _prepare_trie(trie).values(): len(v) > 0

properties.text: Secured tries must hash keys with keccak256 before nibble conversion in _prepare_trie.
properties.assertion: forall trie: trie.secured => mapped_key = bytes_to_nibble_list(keccak256(preimage))

properties.text: Trie root must always be exactly 32 bytes regardless of trie content.
properties.assertion: forall trie: len(root(trie)) == 32

properties.text: Empty trie must return EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT (keccak256(RLP(b''))).
properties.assertion: len(trie._data) == 0 => root(trie) == keccak256(rlp.encode(b''))

properties.text: Empty obj in patricialize must return None; single element must return LeafNode.
properties.assertion: len(obj)==0 => None; len(obj)==1 => LeafNode(key[level:], val)

properties.text: Account, Receipt, Uint must not appear at branch value positions in patricialize.
properties.assertion: forall branch_value in patricialize: not isinstance(branch_value, (Account, Receipt, Uint))

properties.text: Recursive patricialize calls must strictly increase level parameter, ensuring termination.
properties.assertion: forall recursive call patricialize(obj, l'): l' > l (current level)

properties.text: Account encoding requires get_storage_root callback to be non-None.
properties.assertion: forall acct in trie._data: isinstance(acct, Account) => get_storage_root is not None

properties.text: After trie_set with non-default value, trie_get must return that value.
properties.assertion: forall k,v: v != default && trie_set(trie,k,v) => trie_get(trie,k) == v

properties.text: After trie_set with default value, trie_get must return default.
properties.assertion: forall k: trie_set(trie, k, default) => trie_get(trie, k) == default

properties.text: Deterministic root: same trie._data must always produce the same root hash.
properties.assertion: forall t1,t2: t1._data == t2._data => root(t1) == root(t2)

properties.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all state data from remote peers must be fully validated.
properties.assertion: forall peer_data: received_via_p2p(peer_data) => validated(peer_data) before trie_set

properties.text: Engine API is JWT-authenticated; only authenticated CL can trigger state root computation.
properties.assertion: forall caller: root(trie) invoked via EngineAPI => caller.hasValidJWT == true

properties.text: BLS signature verification rejects invalid blocks before state transitions are applied.
properties.assertion: forall block: apply_state_transition(block) => bls_verify(block.signature) == true

properties.text: Tampering: crafted txns must not produce inconsistent state roots across client implementations.
properties.assertion: forall tx, client1, client2: apply(tx, client1).root == apply(tx, client2).root

properties.text: DoS: pathological key distributions must not cause unbounded recursion depth in patricialize.
properties.assertion: forall obj: patricialize(obj, level).recursion_depth <= 2 * max_key_length

properties.text: DoS: malformed state data triggering assertion in _prepare_trie must not crash the client.
properties.assertion: forall input: _prepare_trie(input) raises AssertionError => client remains operational

properties.text: Elevation: state root manipulation must not cause fork choice to accept an invalid chain.
properties.assertion: forall block: fork_choice.accept(block) => block.state_root == compute_root(apply(block.txns))

properties.text: copy_trie must produce independent copy; mutations to copy must not affect original.
properties.assertion: forall trie: copy = copy_trie(trie); trie_set(copy,k,v) => trie_get(trie,k) == original_val

properties.text: Optimization: any cached or precomputed trie root must match full recomputation result.
properties.assertion: forall trie: cached_root(trie) == root(trie) (full recompute)

properties.text: Optimization: deduplicated encode_internal_node calls must return same result as non-cached path.
properties.assertion: forall node: cached_encode(node) == encode_internal_node(node)

properties.text: Optimization: incremental trie updates must produce same root as full rebuild from scratch.
properties.assertion: forall ops: incremental_root(trie, ops) == root(rebuild_trie(trie._data after ops))
